spec.name: Reversal v34
spec.notes: Mean reversion of recent returns across names.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.5, annual return 11%, maximum drawdown 5%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy lacks sufficient documentation and empirical validation. With no exhibits provided to substantiate the performance claims or the research process, the court cannot verify the robustness of the 'Reversal v34' model. The lack of transparency regarding data sources and transaction cost modeling poses a significant risk to real capital. Consequently, the strategy is relegated to paper trading to allow for the collection of out-of-sample performance data. The agent must provide comprehensive evidence of backtesting integrity and risk management before any deployment of capital will be considered.
